scope: CPU-only correctness and algorithmic controls; no IC speedup or deployed-curve claim

prefilter.subgroup: largest odd prime factor, one exact cyclic subgroup; count full curve and verify r*G=0
prefilter.target_law: all nonidentity points of the selected prime-order subgroup, uniform
prefilter.labels: exhaustive ordered three-sum in subgroup scalar coordinates; replay one witness per positive target with original group law
prefilter.features: bits 0..12 of x, trace(alpha*x) for alpha=1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128; n,ell,multiplier,b,usable point count
prefilter.safety: No trained classifier may reject an actual oracle query; report exhaustive false negatives. Zero false negatives in a finite test does not prove necessity. No claim of a new invariant.

program_search.grammar: three-sum membership kernel: ordered exhaustive, pair-index, sorted-pair binary search; base predicate: scalar-multiplied polynomial-prefix subspace using multipliers 1,2,3,5,7
program_search.fitness: count group-scalar additions and dictionary probes on all subgroup targets; setup and searches charged separately; wall times are diagnostics
program_search.replay: each kernel must equal independent exhaustive triple-sum membership for every target and base; selected program frozen before heldout
program_search.mean_yield: record exact multiplicities, support and total ordered tuples; predicate changes never counted as free yield gain
program_search.scope_limit: restricted enumerative program search, not LLM/AlphaEvolve; no compiled code mutation or full IC pipeline

surrogate.deduplicate: full receipt canonical SHA; quarantine conflicting reused run_id; retain timeout/budget/error counters and observed-degree lower bounds
surrogate.response: completed-cell maximum D_solve for mxl, plus completion classification; cost uses recorded counted operations only
surrogate.memory: no per-cell prediction from cumulative process peak RSS
surrogate.split: stable SHA256 of exact curve_id,ell,m,family,formulation,order modulo5: 0 test,1 calibration,2..4 train; whole-shape groups kept together
surrogate.conformal: 90% split residual interval with finite-sample ceil((k+1)*0.9) quantile; if rank exceeds k use unbounded interval
surrogate.coverage: empirical heldout coverage only; no theorem for historical nonrandom corpus, new curves, sizes, presentations or orders
surrogate.prospective_policy: reject unsupported features and sizes; no acquisition decision outside observed hull

sat.model: m=3 symmetric degree<=3 ANF; never direct degree6 S4 reader
sat.learning: enumerate six block permutations on training targets; fit/select least total conflicts, deterministic tie break; transfer coefficient-position order to heldout ell
sat.certification: independently replay every SAT assignment and compare UNSAT with complete small-base group-law membership oracle; no proof-trace/cubing certificate claim
sat.scope_limit: static empirically selected branching order; no neural branching, no cube-and-conquer or XOR-CDCL policy claim

publication: fresh append-only artifacts, source digests, raw inputs/results/failures, report, editable graph and PDF; no official autoresearcher status transition
